name: Michael L. O'Donnell
tagline: Top rated Products Liability attorney in Denver, Colorado

about: Michael L. O'Donnell is an attorney at Wheeler Trigg O'Donnell LLP and helps clients address Personal Injury - Products: Defense legal issues. He also assists clients regarding Class Action / Mass Torts: Defense and Professional Liability: Defense issues.
Super Lawyers is a designation of top-rated practicing attorneys selected through extensive evaluation. He was awarded this distinction for 2006 - 2027.
Michael O'Donnell graduated in 1979 from University of Denver Sturm College of Law.
Michael O'Donnell was admitted to practice law in 1980. He represents clients in the Denver area.
